what: The hardware evidence that qualifies S2 C2-packed-any (QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1): packed rounds at any position through one K64j 0x27 program per bundle (s2-design.md rev 2, W7 and 6.2). packed_any_admission.check_evidence reads it at every c2-packed attach; its sha256 is pinned there (EVIDENCE_SHA256), so a new record changes both in one commit.
provenance: CB1 and CB2a are transcribed from the goal-c2-serving memory note and the S2 build brief (2026-09-26); their run artifacts were not re-read when this file was written. CB2b has not run: until its record is PASS, every c2-packed attach is refused.

binary.build: optimisation/ttnn-op/k64j/build_k64j.sh through the card-B job, card-b-v7 run 36222920898

CB1.what: K64j K1/K3: the runtime extent (0x20) at cur_pos E - 1 equals the compile-time call at capacity E

CB2a.what: K2 (native causal B1 per row == the extent path, bitwise; it sets the exactness policy), X7 (0x7 narrow == 0x7 wide with the real -inf tail) and Z (the 15 stale-writer families in one trace)
CB2a.harness: optimisation/ttnn-op/k64j/k64j_card_b.py --sections K2,X7,Z --seeds 0,1,2,3,4 --variants normal,peaky --no-timing (the cardm action; card B is reserved)

CB2b.what: W10b: the real extent readers over pool-like lent storage - R1 (the pinned mask kernel at capacity 256 == narrow_mask_host), R2 (each segment == the 0x7 compile-time call with the wide -inf mask at capacity E), R4 (idle segments at 0/32 on the zero table), construction staging

required.sources: the sha256 of every file of top-level sources, as the run held them
